zh.independent_solution: 把同一束光分成不同传播路径并使两部分重合，控制光程差稳定，可得到频率相同、相位差稳定的相干光波。独立光源即使同色，也不能仅凭同色保证相位差稳定。
tasks: 说明同束分光并重合的方法
说明相同频率和稳定相位差两个相干条件

zh.independent_solution: 相干光波相遇时，振动叠加使光强随相对相位而增强或减弱，形成稳定的明暗分布。在可相互干涉的偏振条件下，I=I1+I2+2sqrt(I1 I2)cos(delta)；同相增强、反相减弱，反相且等振幅才完全抵消。暗处不代表能量消失，能流重新分配；在透明无吸收增透模型中，减少的反射能量进入透射。
tasks: 给出叠加及明暗增强减弱的机制
区别局部相消与能量消灭

zh.independent_solution: 单色光颜色差异联系频率。真空波长可用lambda0=c/f表征频率；跨静止介质界面f不变而v、lambda可变，所以不能把不同介质内波长的差异直接认作颜色变化。
tasks: 识别颜色所对应的频率
区别频率与介质内波长

zh.independent_solution: 在很薄的空气裂隙、合适照明且两侧反射光可重合的条件下，同一入射光在冰-空气和空气-冰界面形成两束反射光，额外光程随裂隙厚度和入射角变化，对白光不同频率造成不同增强或减弱，出现彩色闪光。这不是任何裂痕都必然发生，也不要求制造裂痕。冰折射率高于空气：冰向空气反射无pi翻转，空气向冰反射有pi翻转；两反射的相对反射相位为pi，不是增透膜两次均翻转的零差。正入射总相位差=4pi*n_air*h/lambda0+pi；理想反射增强满足2*n_air*h=(m+1/2)*lambda0，减弱满足2*n_air*h=m*lambda0，不能不检查折射率次序便套增透膜四分之一波长相消规则。
tasks: 用薄空气层两反射叠加解释彩色
保留厚度、角度和波长选择性
保留观察前提而非所有裂痕保证
避免把冰裂隙与增透膜的反射相位条件混同

zh.independent_solution: 不意味着潜水员不能看见物体。设空气中速度v_air、波长lambda_air，则水中v_water=v_air/n、lambda_water=lambda_air/n，f_water=(v_air/n)/(lambda_air/n)=f_air。静止界面不改变频率，介质内波长缩短本身不把自然可见光变成不可见光；是否看得清还受照明、混浊、吸收和成像条件影响。
tasks: 回答并否定不能看见的推论
由速度与波长同除n推出频率不变
不把波长缩短误当成移出可见频率

zh.independent_solution: 主要应用包括干涉仪的精密测量与检验，例如由条纹和光程变化测光波长、气体折射率；以及光学玻璃的增透处理，用薄膜两反射光的相位安排和振幅匹配减少反射及杂散光。两次同为低折射率向高折射率反射时，反射相位差为零，正入射最薄设计h=lambda_film/4；等振幅才完全相消。白光各频率不都满足同一最佳厚度，真实吸收也不能被忽略。
tasks: 列举干涉测量和检验
列举光学增透
识别应用与干涉的物理联系

en.independent_solution: Split one beam into different paths and recombine the parts with a stable optical-path difference. The parts have the same frequency and a stable relative phase. Independent sources of the same colour do not by that fact alone maintain a stable phase difference.
tasks: Explain common-beam splitting and recombination
Identify equal frequency and stable phase difference

en.independent_solution: Superposition of overlapping coherent light waves produces phase-dependent reinforcement and weakening, giving a stable bright-dark distribution. For compatible polarizations I=I1+I2+2sqrt(I1 I2)cos(delta). In phase reinforces; opposite phase weakens, with complete cancellation only for equal amplitudes. A dark region is not destroyed energy; energy flow is redistributed. In an ideal nonabsorbing antireflection system, reduced reflection increases transmission.
tasks: Define superposition and reinforcement/weakening
Distinguish local cancellation from destruction of energy

en.independent_solution: Differences in single-frequency colour are associated with frequency. Vacuum wavelength lambda0=c/f is a proxy, but wavelength in a medium also depends on propagation speed. A stationary interface leaves frequency unchanged while speed and wavelength may change, so cross-medium wavelengths alone do not decide colour.
tasks: Identify frequency as the colour property
Distinguish frequency from in-medium wavelength

en.independent_solution: Under suitable illumination, a sufficiently thin air gap in ice can produce overlapping reflections from its two boundaries. Extra optical path depends on thickness and angle; different frequencies in white light are reinforced or weakened differently, yielding coloured glints. This is conditional, not guaranteed for every fracture, and is an explanation rather than a request to make cracks. With n_ice>n_air, the ice-to-air reflection has no pi reversal while the air-to-ice reflection has one: relative reflection phase pi. At normal incidence delta=4pi*n_air*h/lambda0+pi, so ideal reflected maxima occur at 2*n_air*h=(m+1/2)*lambda0 and minima at 2*n_air*h=m*lambda0. The coating's quarter-wave cancellation rule cannot simply be transferred to this reversed index ordering.
tasks: Explain colour through two thin-gap reflections
Preserve thickness, angle and spectral selection
Preserve conditional observation
Distinguish air-gap and coating reflection-phase conditions

en.independent_solution: No. For the given relative refractive index, v_water=v_air/n and lambda_water=lambda_air/n. Therefore f_water=(v_air/n)/(lambda_air/n)=f_air. Wavelength shortening at a stationary boundary does not by itself make naturally visible light invisible. Visibility still depends on illumination, scattering, absorption and imaging conditions.
tasks: Reject the asserted loss of underwater visibility
Derive invariant frequency from speed and wavelength
Reject applying an air-wavelength visible range to water alone

en.independent_solution: Principal applications here are interferometric precision measurements and tests, including wavelength and gas refractive index from optical-path/fringe changes, and antireflection treatment of optical glass. Coatings arrange opposite relative phase and matched reflected amplitudes to reduce reflection and stray light. With two low-to-high reflections, reflection phase changes cancel relatively; the thinnest normal-incidence choice is h=lambda_film/4, with complete cancellation only for equal amplitudes. One optimum thickness does not cancel all white-light frequencies, and real absorption cannot be ignored.
tasks: List interferometric measurements and tests
List antireflection treatment
Link the applications to interference

bilingual_equivalence: The six source tasks and selected definitions preserve the same frequency, phase, optical-path and energy conditions in both locales. Chinese subscripts retained in the English seed are labels, not changed equations.
